name: Shaw Needs To Know
summary: Matthias Shaw needs you to bring him urgent news in Stormwind. He warns that its handling could affect the city’s people.

sections.title: Back to Shaw
sections.body: In Stormwind, Matthias Shaw reads the words you bring and asks you to keep the news to yourself. He says it must be handled carefully for the sake of the city’s people.

faq.answer: Matthias Shaw in Stormwind needs you to bring him the news.

faq.q: Why should I keep it private?
faq.answer: Shaw says that if word spreads before they are ready, things will go badly for Stormwind’s people.

faq.q: What does Shaw do with the news?
faq.answer: Shaw reads the words on the page and says he will take it from there.
The news is described as potentially disastrous for Stormwind, but its contents are not stated here.
